message.content: {"summary":"Strong Part 1 submission. Your reef-monitoring mission concept is clear, well-justified and well referenced, and your Gantt plan is detailed and mission-linked. To reach the top of the rubric, add quantitative mission requirements, resolve the Gantt sequencing inconsistency, include contingency provisions, show preliminary technical results (e.g. orbit/coverage in STK), and adopt a formal referencing style.","next_steps":["Add quantitative mission requirements (e.g. revisit time, spatial resolution, latency) and discuss the LEO vs GEO coverage trade-off behind your near-real-time relay claim","Fix the Gantt sequencing so STK Simulations does not start before STK Design, and add contingency/variation provisions to the plan","Include preliminary technical results from STK (orbit parameters, coverage, or link budget) with brief interpretation, and replace bare-URL citations with a formal reference list cited in text"],"criteria":{"C1":"Accomplished (8/10). Your Mission Concept & Rationale clearly states the purpose (GBR bleaching monitoring), identifies users (marine and conservation scientists), and justifies need with statistics and four cited sources. To reach the top of the range, define specific, measurable mission objectives and requirements, and address the orbit/coverage implications of your near-real-time relay claim.","C2":"Accomplished (7/10). Your Gantt chart is detailed, week-by-week, and tied to mission stages (launch, orbit, ground control, comms, end-of-life), with planned sources identified. To strengthen it, add explicit contingency/variation provisions and resolve the inconsistency where STK Simulations runs from Week 4 but STK Design starts Week 7.","C3":"Adequate (5/10). Your progress so far is background research (Asner's Hawaii system, coral bleaching) and STK tutorials 1–4, which is a reasonable start but not yet technical output. The next level requires a preliminary set of results — e.g. an orbit or coverage simulation in STK — with brief description and interpretation.","C4":"Accomplished (7/10). Your report has a clear structure, consistent formatting, and a well-labelled Gantt chart with legend. Deductions arise from bare-URL in-text citations and 'Useful Links' not cited in the text. Adopt a formal referencing style (e.g. IEEE) with a matching reference list to reach the top level."}}
